name: FireFlieS
author: Jabubu11
description: Move up at 41% between the spike and saw and move back down shortly after to avoid the size and gravity portal. Fly up between the spike and saw at 42% and then land on top of the blocks with the spikes under them (don’t touch the ceiling whilst doing so). Don’t click to fall back into the gameplay at 43.6% as the ship. Navigate through the following gameplay as the ship until 52% where you have to fly above the yellow pad and then do an invisible straightfly while staying above the floor and avoiding the size portal, orb, invisible spikes and invisible saw. At 53.5%, you can move to the floor. Hold to the ceiling at 74% and then release at 77% to land on an invisible platform. At 79% after touching the yellow pad, start playing through the gameplay as the ship. Enter the ship portal at 90%, play the level normally from there.
